title: Tropical Minimalism

content: The project adopts a contemporary Brutalist language, combining the raw beauty of concrete with minimalist timber screens and lush tropical greenery. The design seeks to create a contemporary living environment. Conceived as a mixed-use residential and commercial model within a green urban district, the project is planned to optimize operational efficiency while creating living and business spaces that harmonize with the surrounding landscape. Architecture, nature, and function are carefully balanced to offer a resort-like experience in the heart of the city.
